# MILO v1.4.0 (10400)
*“Track your day. Understand your habits. See your progress. Become better than yesterday.”*

### Release Highlights
- **Interactive Milo Mascot**: 8 emotional states (Calm, Happy, Proud, Curious, Encouraging, Sleepy, Celebrating, Welcoming) with reactive canvas rendering.
- **Productivity Scoring Engine**: Modular 0-100 score balancing task completion, time adherence, deep focus, habits, and routine consistency.
- **Multi-Scale Schedule**: Seamless Day, Week, and Month time-blocking.
- **Habit Consistency Matrix**: 7-day visual grids and 4-week velocity curves without streak-shaming.
- **Monthly Life Report**: Signature retrospective (*“You showed up.”*).
- **Offline-First Room Persistence**: Battery-optimized Room DB with WorkManager background sync.
- **Verified In-App Updates**: Client-side SHA-256 checksum verification.
